items.name: Brinewhisper
items.words: A gutting knife honed on Brineglass until it sang.

items.name: Harbourwarden
items.words: Carried by Overlook's watch on the harbour wall, and never once surrendered.

items.name: Anchorhead
items.words: Its head was cast from a drowned ship's anchor.

items.name: Mooring Chain
items.words: Two fathoms of harbour chain and a lump of iron, and it holds whatever it meets.

items.name: Wreckbreaker
items.words: Made to cut a boarding party's way through a hull, and through the party.

items.name: Breakwater
items.words: The sea breaks on it. So does everything else.

items.name: Beaconstaff
items.words: Cut from the timber of Overlook's first beacon, it still seems to hold the light.

items.name: Stormpetrel
items.words: Named for the bird that flies ahead of a storm. Its arrows do too.

items.name: Harpooner
items.words: Its bolts were first cut for whales.

items.name: Quarterdeck
items.words: An officer's piece, for keeping order on deck.

items.name: Broadside
items.words: One shot, and the argument is over.

items.name: Seawall
items.words: A harbour's wall, made small enough to carry.

items.name: Tidegate
items.words: The tide-gate's keeper held the narrow way with a knife and the gate's own iron shutter.

items.name: Crosscurrent
items.words: Two blades that meet like the currents at the harbour mouth, and pull under whatever they catch.

items.name: The Bollards
items.words: Cast in a pair for the quay. They have held ships fast, and stopped boarders faster.

items.name: Keeper's Watch
items.words: The lighthouse keeper's cudgel, and the iron door he shut on the wreckers.

items.name: Longshore
items.words: Forged for the shore watch, and long enough to hold a beach alone.

items.name: Signal Pair
items.words: Fired one after the other from the harbour wall: one shot for danger, one for the dead.

items.name: Tithebreaker Helm
items.words: Forged to meet the Grey Tithe's boarders, and to be the last thing they see.

items.name: Tithebreaker Plate
items.words: It has turned more cutlasses than any wall in Overlook.

items.name: Tithebreaker Gauntlets
items.words: Heavy enough to hold a line, light enough to hold a blade.

items.name: Tithebreaker Greaves
items.words: Planted on a deck in a storm, they do not move.

items.name: Saltwind Hood
items.words: Oiled against the spray, and against being seen.

items.name: Saltwind Jerkin
items.words: Sailcloth and sharkskin, stitched by someone who knew the sea.

items.name: Saltwind Bracers
items.words: Rope-burned, salt-stained, and all the better for it.

items.name: Saltwind Breeches
items.words: For running the rigging, and running down whatever fled it.

items.name: The Drowned Oath
items.words: Sworn on the deck of a ship that never came home. The oath was kept.

items.name: Lanternfall
items.words: When the lanterns went out over the bay, this was the last light anyone saw.

items.name: The Last Bell
items.words: Rung once for every ship the bell-tower lost.

items.name: Gullwing
items.words: Strung with gull sinew. It wants to fly.

items.name: The Reefwall
items.words: Coral grew over it on the seabed for a hundred years. Nothing has broken it since.

items.name: Crown of the Drowned
items.words: Those who wear it remember what it was to drown, and do not mean to again.

items.name: Wreckhide
items.words: Hide from something the sea threw up, tougher than any ship it wrecked.

items.name: Tidecaller's Grips
items.words: Turn the tide with them, they say. Or at least the blade.

items.name: Driftwalkers
items.words: Light as driftwood, and as hard to catch.

items.name: Harbour Cloak
items.words: Plain wool, proof against Overlook's harbour wind.

items.name: Stormcloak
items.words: Waxed canvas the colour of a squall.

items.name: Pale Mantle
items.words: The grey of the Pale Expanse at dawn.

items.name: The Long Nines
items.words: Nine-pounders bored long, that reach where shorter guns fall short.

items.name: Kraken's Roar
items.words: Guns cast from a bell that rang under the sea.

items.name: Ironbound Keel
items.words: A keel banded in iron from stem to stern.

items.name: Leviathan's Rib
items.words: Its ribs are a sea beast's, and no ball has broken one.

items.name: Windmaiden's Canvas
items.words: Canvas woven in Sunspire, light as a gull's wing.

items.name: Stormcaller's Sheet
items.words: A sail that fills when no wind blows.

items.name: Gallowglass Rigging
items.words: Line spun by Rimeholt's ropewalks, that never frays in the cold.

items.name: The Spider's Web
items.words: Rigging so close-set that boarders climb it like a stair.

items.name: Stormcallers' Cape
items.words: Worn by those pledged to the Stormcallers. It hangs as if a wind were always rising.

items.name: Lamplighters' Cape
items.words: Worn by those pledged to the Lamplighters. Its hem is singed, and none of them mend it.

items.name: Cape of the Veiled
items.words: Worn by those pledged to the Veiled. It is hard to say where its edge is.

items.name: Stormcaller Helm
items.words: Its crest stands up a moment before the lightning comes.

items.name: Stormcaller Hauberk
items.words: Light enough to run in, as every Stormcaller must.

items.name: Stormcaller Gauntlets
items.words: The knuckles are scorched from the inside.

items.name: Stormcaller Greaves
items.words: Made for quick feet on a wet deck.

items.name: Squallbreak
items.words: A blade, and a shield to stand behind when the squall it calls comes in.

items.name: Thunderstring
items.words: Its string hums before a storm, and the Stormcallers listen.

items.name: Lamplighter Hood
items.words: Pale as the first light in a harbour window.

items.name: Lamplighter Vestments
items.words: Mended so often that none of the first cloth is left.

items.name: Lamplighter Gloves
items.words: Warm, as if they had only now set down a lamp.

items.name: Lamplighter Boots
items.words: Worn thin on the steps up to every lamp in Overlook.

items.name: Wickstaff
items.words: A lamplighter's pole, made heavy enough to keep the dark back.

items.name: Dawnflight
items.words: Its arrows are fletched in white, so the lost can follow them home.

items.name: Veiled Cowl
items.words: No one remembers the face beneath it, which is the point.

items.name: Veiled Coat
items.words: It drinks the lamplight and gives none of it back.

items.name: Veiled Grips
items.words: They leave no mark on anything they touch.

items.name: Veiled Treads
items.words: Soft on stone, and silent on a deck.

items.name: Hushguard
items.words: A knife for the work, and a buckler for when the work goes wrong.

items.name: Nightpin
items.words: Its arrows come out of the dark and go back into it.
